about_the_game:
You will have to play as fighters against evil and monsters in the world of Slavic mythology, as well as craft and build some buildings of your camp to improve weapons, armor and cooking.

The cooperative mode will allow you to go through an exciting story with a group of friends, as well as your friends will provide you with great help in the battle with the enemy.;

Crafting and building will allow you to diversify the gameplay and relax and recuperate a little before the next adventures.;

There are different weapons with different characteristics in the game, some (rare) weapons will be available only after completing certain quests or obtained in battle against bosses.;

From day to night, as well as the open world will allow the player to fully immerse themselves in the world of the game for many, many hours.

A variety of story tasks will not let even the most sophisticated player get bored.;
